Text:
One single continuous photograph — no panels, grids, or split frames.

Use the uploaded photo as the exact base composition. The street in the source
is empty — populate it with the people and vehicles specified below. Remove all
modern businesses, logos, brands, storefront names, banners, advertisements, and
signage visible in the source image.

PRESERVE (must match source exactly)
- camera: eye-level, street-facing, fov 76
- residential road, 2-lane, asphalt
- sidewalks present, curbs present
- driveways: corner entrance apron; parking: concrete apron in front of the bays
- small office with plate glass building at corner of the lot, 1 story, brick veneer, plate glass, flat parapet roof, 20 feet from road setback
- service bay row under one continuous roof building at rear of the lot, 1 story, concrete block, corrugated metal, flat roof, 40 feet from road setback
- utilities: overhead power lines, utility pole at the corner
- landscape: narrow grass strip along the road, gravel edge along the apron
- immutable elements: painted sign band across the parapet, corner lot at the intersection, concrete apron in front of the service bays
Keep this location instantly recognizable.

OUTPUT FORMAT
Create a TRUE 9:16 vertical portrait. Expand the SAME scene naturally above
(sky) and below (street/pavement) as canvas extension — do not stretch or
distort the source geometry.

TRANSFORM TO 1995
Clinton era prosperity. An ordinary 1995 American commercial street — backlit box signs, rounded cars, the video store era at full strength.

PERIOD DETAILS
- MAIN STREET DINER with 'HOT COFFEE 75¢' in the window
- video rental store with a backlit 'VIDEO RENTALS' sign and a 'BE KIND, REWIND' sticker
- music store with a 'CDs — CASSETTES' sign
- window signs: 'SUB COMBO $3.99', 'HAIRCUT $8'
- the old ghost-sign almost fully faded
- rollerblades leaning by a door
Typography: clean geometric sans-serif, early digital influence.
Sign text is only what appears in quotes — do not turn other words from this prompt into signage.

PEOPLE
EXACTLY 8 people TOTAL: 3 near sidewalk (largest, foreground), 3 opposite sidewalk mid-block, 2 distant, far end of block. Grouped in pairs, threes, and singles.
- a woman talking on a wall-mounted payphone
- a man walking a dog
- a dad carrying a kid on his shoulders
Clothing: men in flannel shirts, baggy jeans; women in floral dresses, crop tops. Fashion palette: forest green, maroon, mustard yellow. No posing or eye contact. All people stay on sidewalks, at storefronts, or beside parked vehicles — never standing, sitting, or walking in the road or driving lanes.

VEHICLES
EXACTLY 5 period vehicles, all different:
- 1993-1997 Ford Ranger — compact pickup, straight lines — navy blue
- 1992-1995 Honda Civic — small rounded coupe and sedan — burgundy
- 1986-1997 Ford Aerostar — boxy rear-drive minivan — teal
- 1991-1994 Saturn SL — plastic body panels, compact — hunter green
- 1988-1998 Chevrolet C/K 1500 — softly squared pickup — black
Parked with gaps; no vehicle newer than 1995.
Parked vehicles hug the curb — parallel, each facing its lane's direction; none sideways, diagonal, or against traffic. Keep at least one full driving lane clear each way for through traffic.
PLACEMENT: three parked on the RIGHT side; the rest parked on the LEFT side. No vehicle in the same spot as any other era.

ENVIRONMENT
- road markings: yellow center line, white edge lines, turn lane arrows
- utilities: overhead power lines standard, cable TV and early phone data lines on poles

TREES
- maple tree at street corner: clearly smaller than in the source — about 45% of its canopy there, thinner trunk
- elm tree at side yard: a young tree, only about 25% of its canopy in the source photo, thin trunk
Tree sizes MUST follow this specification even where they differ from the source photo.

PHOTOGRAPHIC STYLE
COLOR photograph — Kodak Gold 200 or Fujifilm Superia 200 look.
Color: neutral to slightly warm tones. Grain: fine grain, cleaner than 1985.
Photorealistic — NOT black-and-white, no HDR.

PRIVACY
Blur all faces and license plates.
SelectedVehicles: 1993-1997 Ford Ranger — compact pickup, straight lines
1992-1995 Honda Civic — small rounded coupe and sedan
1991-1994 Saturn SL — plastic body panels, compact
